name: Matter coverage plan for absences
summary: When leave or a staffing change takes someone away from active matters, the practice manager gets a draft coverage plan: a proposed cover for each matter, the attorney-confirmed dates in the absence, the access each cover needs and every handoff that is blocked. The practice lead and responsible attorneys decide.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of law-firm work: the illustrative entry for planning cover of active matters when someone is away.
